posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
A few clarifications:

  • Even if your private test case evaluation was unable to run during OPPE due to server load, we have rerun all your submissions’ for private test cases after the OPPE. So if your code works, it will be considered.
  • If your code works for public but not for private test cases, it is likely your code does not cover some corner cases, or the output formatting is not as expected. For a correct solution, it has been verified that both public and private test cases pass.

855 students have correctly solved this question and got 100 for this, therefore there are no evaluation issues from our side.

Screenshot 2025-08-20 at 09.36.341010×1552 144 KB

posts.name: Akshat Shethia
posts.cooked:
Thank you for the clarification, sir. I completely understand that both public and private test cases must pass for a correct solution. However, I’m still finding it difficult to understand how my code could pass all 10/10 public test cases but fail in 0/10 private test cases.

Would it be possible to know what kind of corner cases or formatting issues might typically cause such a complete mismatch? That would really help me identify where my solution is going wrong.

Best regards,
Akshat Shethia

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Usually, if you do not have a \n in the last line, or if you use \r\n instead of \n.
These are some examples.

Ideally the solution is pretty simple:

while read line; do
    username=${line%%:*}
    echo "${username,,}"
done
